overrides.real_en: Lid...
To think that Veritas of the Dark was actually Raegen...
What's gotten into you, Lid? You're being bold!
Raegen.
Raegen! Raegen!
So no matter how much time passes, I'm still Raegen to you, huh...
Raegen has a certain rugged charm, doesn't he?
I understand, Raegen.
Raegen, about the vision crystals we found beneath our house...

So you've finally made it this far...
I always believed you would, Rain.
Rain, would you like to challenge the Super Advanced tier?
Rain, would you like to challenge the Super Advanced tier again?

Congratulations!
Rain, you've now conquered
the entire Colosseum.

Your splendid battles, Rain,
will be spoken of in this Colosseum forever.
Don’t call Raegen “that guy.” He’s your own father.
Even among Grandshelt’s knights, Raegen had earned His Majesty’s particular trust...
Raegen gave me this key and told me to use it if anything ever threatened the Crystals.
Maybe Raegen foresaw what was going to happen.
When my parents died, Raegen raised me like his own son. I’ll never forget what he did for me.
Remember when you tried to force it open and Raegen scolded you?
Yes. The key Raegen left us led us here. I think I'll trust it.
It would be dangerous for Emma to go to the Kolobos Ruins alone...
Emma, where do you live?
Emma!
Emma was trying to go to the Kolobos Ruins to see her mother.
Emma... You haven't told these people?
The expedition Emma's mother joined went to the Kolobos Ruins and never came back.
So Emma's mother, too...
...Emma, I understand how you feel. But...
Emma!?
Emma, are you hurt?
The expedition members are there too, right!? Give Emma her mother back!
But because of that, the chief... I don't know what to tell Emma...
Emma... I hope she feels better...

It's a pleasure to welcome you,
Rain.
Hey, Rain! Teach me how to use a sword!
Having Scott here would be very reassuring.
Scott has been working late every day to rebuild the airship squadron... We practically have to force him to take a break.
The citizens come first! You'll have to wait too, Rain!
Rain... No, please let me call you Boss!
If Rain takes part, the crowd's sure to get excited. Please, give it a try and show us your skills!
Scott has been working late every day to rebuild the airship squadron... We practically have to force him to take a break.
Wow! It's Rain! Look how much I've grown!
My, Rain, how strong you've grown...! Are you eating properly?
Rain! You've come back to Mitra!
I heard you became a captain! That's Rain for you!
Evan!?
Evan... Are you involved with the Sworn Six!?
...Thank you, Rain.
Nichol, the soldier sent to scout the Cave of Waters has returned. Apparently, monsters have appeared there...
Brother!
Brother, who are these people?

Brother!
Ruruka!
Brother, I'm a Warden of Water too, one of the three siblings. Let me come with you...

Arsha is helping everyone evacuate.
But the situation is dangerous.
Who's Arsha?

Fina, have you been traveling
with Rain and the others all this time?

Brother!
Ruruka!
Brother, I'm one of the three siblings who serve as Wardens of Water. Let me fulfill our duty alongside you.

Arsha is helping everyone evacuate.
But the situation is dangerous.
Who's Arsha?
Brother, I'm sorry. I went off on my own without permission...
Nichol, please don't blame El.
Brother, leave the city's recovery to me and go with Ruruka.
Don't you have someone like that, Fina?
Please don't look like that. That isn't like you, Brother. Aren't we Wardens of Water?

Fina,
what do you think?

Fina, is there someone in your life?
Someone special like that?

Hehe.
That's a secret between Fina and me.
...Thank you, Fina.
Nichol, what should we do?
Nichol, may I come with you?
Thank you, Brother.
Brother... You shielded me...?
Brother... Just hearing you say that... I...

El! No! Don't die!
If you die, Arsha will...

Arsha...
El...
Arsha...
Arsha... Take this.

I’m sure this crystal
will keep protecting you.
Thank you, Rain.
...Rain.
(I've never forgotten what Raegen said to me back then.)
Raegen...
I wonder where Raegen is now, and what he's doing.
That’s the name of Raegen’s signature move.

I was so happy...
I couldn't wait to show Raegen Tranquility.

And then...
I realized once again that I wasn't
Raegen's real child...
Raegen took me in and raised me all those years.
...It was Raegen.
You're using Raegen's Crimson Saber, aren't you? It's the same thing.
Raegen...
I want to be strong! Stronger than Rain, even stronger than Raegen!
I refuse to give up! Even if I'm not Raegen's son, even if I'm less talented than Rain!
That was when Raegen told me this sword was the one meant for me.
Jake!
Evan...
Evan... Why have you become like this?
Jake, please! You must save Crown Prince Shera!
Jake?
Shera, you're safe. But His Majesty the Emperor...
Evan... Why did you join someone like him?
Evan...
Lid, don't let it bother you. Don't listen to that fraud of a scientist.
Evan...
Lasswell, let's leave this to Lid.
Evan! Please, snap out of it!
...Evan.
It's okay, Evan. I'm going to save you.
Evan...?
Evan... What do you mean you need money for <text style="italic">me</>?
Evan... So that was why.
Evan...
Evan...?
If you die here, Lid will carry that pain for the rest of her life.
I'm Jake. Lid's boyfriend.
Yeah, Evan!
Oh, I see. So that's why Amelia called you Jake...
Sakura!
Don't worry, Lid. I'll protect you.
Hey! Fina's appearance just changed!
Then where did the Fina we've known until now go?

The innocent Fina
and the sexy Fina...
Personally, I'd like them both to stay...
Sakura, please wait. The teleportation device isn't working right now.
*sigh* ...I guess I’m still nowhere near as well-known as Sol or Dark Fina...
Hm? You know Dark Fina?
Listen. That other Fina is in love with you.
And what do you say? That both versions of Fina are precious to you?
It's fine to love both versions of Fina.

Tell each version of Fina,
"You're the one I truly love."

That's definitely Thunderclap's voice...
She sounds younger, but it's Sakura.
Whoa, what's going on!? Fina... there are two of her!
To think Veritas of the Dark was Raegen...
When Veritas of the Dark saved me, I felt a warmth that reminded me of Raegen.
Sister, are you really determined to destroy every Crystal?
Sister...
Don’t worry, Lid. I’m in the same boat.
Don't people from Paladia have long lifespans? Sakura and the others are still alive.
I can't wait to see how much cuter Fina's gotten!
I'm sorry, Sister... But people can't help changing. Please understand.
...Sister.
Sister...!?
Sister, you're only chasing an illusion.
Sister...!?
Sister, you're awake?
No. I could never kill you, Sister...
I don't think Sophia would be happy to see you wield your sword for revenge...
Sister...
Your feelings are easy enough to read, Lid.
Raegen!?
Raegen, what have you been doing all this time?
Raegen...
Sakura, where is Raegen?
Brother! I passed the Olderion army entrance exam!
I want to serve Olderion too, just like you and Ruruka.
If I do it right, maybe I can become like you...
Thank you, Nichol...
We're comrades. What's wrong with laughing and crying together? Though Lid's always angry!
Raegen!
But Raegen...
Raegen...
Hey, Lid! You're welcome to throw your arms around me!
Evan... How did you get here...?
Sister, you too...
Thank you, Sister. I really appreciate your help.
I feel much better knowing you're coming too, Sister.
Sister!
Sister...
Sister, no! You can't disappear!
Sister...
What is it, Lid...?
Sister... Watch me fight!
Lid, stay back!
You’ll sink too, Lid!
Lid, no!
Lid...
Brother, please.
Jake, our people are praying for all of you to return safely.
May Rain and the others win.
Lid, don't come this way!
Lid will sink too!
Lid, don't!
Lid...
Brother, please.
Praying for Rain and the others to win.
Raegen!
Raegen, can you stand?

Well, well, look at you!
Is that you, Rain!?

Sorry about that.
You've grown so much
I mistook you for Raegen.
What happened to Sophia was such a shame...

But it's true, you know,
that Raegen cared deeply for his family.

You might not remember, Rain,
but whenever I saw your family around town,
you always looked so happy together.
Rain, come with me.

Raegen told me
that this flower only grows in Olderion's Waterfall Way.
It was Raegen who placed that flower here.
He said it was Sophia's favorite flower.

Raegen comes back to town once a year
to place this flower here.

I figured he'd visit around this time again.
That's why I mistook you, Rain,
for Raegen.
Rain, you haven't seen Raegen all this time?

Once, when Raegen came to town,
I asked if he'd seen
Rain and Lasswell.
Raegen had a clumsy side to him.

Looks like you're the same, Rain.
You came all this way
to learn about Raegen.

Well then, I'll be on my way.
Give Raegen my regards.

Yeah.
So Raegen came all this way alone
to pick this flower...

Someday, I'm going to become
a knight of Grandshelt like Raegen.
Oh, if it isn’t Lid.

The truly remarkable people are
airship engineers like Lid and everyone working on site.
Lid, don't tell me you're...

Lid, please,
don't do anything reckless.
Oh, Evan. No, I only just got here myself.
What do you think, Evan?
Thanks, Evan.
All right, Evan. I'm counting on you.
Oh, Lid.

Lid...
So you've made the part your parents designed.

I once asked Lid's parents
something, you know.

Those were the words of the first Cid,
but Lid's parents used to say them too.
Nichol!
I have a message from Shera.
But I see now you've been looking beyond that, Brother.
Brother...
Hey, it's Sakura!
Hi, Sakura! Hey, will you teach us some magic?
Aw, Sakura! You <text style="italic">always</> say that!
Bye, Sakura!
Sakura!
Yeah! We want to show you, Sakura!
Yeah! We really want you to teach us magic, Sakura!
Promise, Sakura!

Why are you here...?
Even Shera...
Shera...

Shera, you're too kind.
You're like a light shining over Zoldaad.
I'm sorry... Even though you went so far as to give me a false identity...

But if I don't return,
Shera and Zoldaad could come to harm...
...Shera.

Please... Shera...
While I served you...
I was truly happy...
Shera...
Rain! Jake!
Shera, it's nearly time for your next official duty.

I disabled the train's brakes on Lazarov's orders...
but I got caught in the accident myself...

I disabled the train's brakes on Lazarov's orders...
but I got caught in the accident myself...

That's right, that's right.
Just as Rain said.
If there's a reason, please tell us.

Rain! Master Sakura!
Thank you so much for everything this time!

I saw you scatter that powder!
Then Victoria crumbled away like sand!!
You want to hear about Aileen?

Jake and the others played their part,
but the revolution would never have succeeded without her weapons.
Nichol, the Warden, is fighting to protect the whole world now, not just Olderion, right?
Supply lines are the key to victory!... That's something Nichol always says. Come on, take a look!

Rain, I once served
Emperor Shera.

At Emperor Shera's command,
I'm here to assist you, Rain,
and all your companions.

This painting...
I made it at Emperor Sozhe's request
when he was still young.

Back then, Emperor Sozhe
was burning with ideals...
Shera may be quiet, but there's a burning passion inside him. In that, he's much like his father.
I've served at this castle ever since Shera was little.
It's Shera's era now. Zoldaad will be fine. The castle is lively again, just like it used to be.
The throne room is just ahead. Shera seems to be looking forward to meeting you all.
Shera... He's so young, yet he carries so much on his shoulders...

Those bookshelves...
I hear Emperor Sozhe used to read the books there.
I'm going to become a maid at this castle, a wonderful maid just like Amelia.
Thank you for rescuing Shera safely.
Thank you for rescuing Shera safely.
Please keep looking after Shera from now on.
Perhaps I underestimated Shera a little.
Shera is too kind. I thought it would be better for him never to encounter the dark world I once lived in...
But I was wrong. Shera's compassion is vast enough to embrace everything...
Thank you for rescuing Shera safely.

Those bookshelves...
I hear Emperor Sozhe used to read the books there.

Even if I run out of magic...
Even if I have to give up my life...
I will protect Fina, no matter what.

Sol is a kind person.
He bears no hatred even toward the people of Aldore.

The difference in strength with Aldore
would be easy to overcome
with Behemoth on our side.
Did you know? Siren is said to be breathtakingly beautiful, but she apparently also has the power to charm people.
I love Siren's singing! But... she hasn't sung lately. I wonder if she caught a cold...
Siren sang again! It was wonderful, just like always...!
It's my dream to sing in front of Siren someday!
Emma is a strong girl, even after everything that's happened...
Emma had only just started smiling again after her father's accident.
Please, don't let anything happen to make Emma sad again...
If Emma doesn't come back either, I...
Please... bring Emma home.
I'll shower Emma with love, enough for my younger sister—her mother—as well.
You brought Emma back!
I'm sorry I keep asking for favors. Please take care of Emma.
Rolan plays with us a lot and even cooks for us!
We came to play with Rolan, but it looks like he's not here...

I admired the original Cid,
so I became an engineer in this country.

What are you saying?
If you marry Shera, you'll be the empress!
You do understand that, right?

But seeing that it helped Jake...
I realized it must have been made
for this very moment.

I hear Shera is already
abolishing the heavy taxes.

From now on, Shera will make this country better
in his father's place, won't he?

Zoldaad will surely become a better country
under Shera's rule.

Aileen inspected our old weapons,
met with each of us, and then
made new weapons for us.
I’m counting on you, Jake.

—Surveyors Wanted in Felicitas—

By order of the King of Grandshelt, we are conducting a geological survey of the Kolobos continent.

But... this continent is huge, and surveying it is no easy task.

Want to learn about the Crystals?
Want to uncover history through the earth's layers?
Want the king to praise you?
Want Chloe to praise you, too?

If that sounds like you, then yes, you!
Give poor, delicate Professor Chloe a hand!

Advertiser: Professor Chloe

Would you like to rest, Rain?
Our beds are made up beautifully,
no less so than those in the castle.

Farewell, Rain.
May your journey be a good one.

Rain, have a good day.
Whenever you wish to rest, just let me know.

Rain, it seems you don't have enough gil.
We charge a fee
to operate an inn aboard the airship...
Well, I’m sure Rain already knows.
Even Rain has to start at the Beginner tier.
We have high hopes for you, Rain.
Thank you... Rain.
Rain, I believe our enemies aren't ordinary soldiers, but some kind of undead...
You can still call me 'Big Sis Chloe,' like you used to. I looked after you when you were little, after all.
B-Big Sis Chloe...

That's right! You used to come see me every day
and call me that.
I called you Rain, too.
That's right. Well then, I'm counting on you, Rain!
Well then, perhaps we'll meet again somewhere, Rain.
So, Rain... please look at this stone.
Oh... It seems you already have a tablet fragment, Rain.
Rain, how have things been since then?
If another great calamity befalls the world... Rain, I ask you to protect Lapis when that time comes.
Are you friends of Rolan?
We came to play with Rolan!
Rolan is at work. I think he'll be home soon.
Rolan works from early morning until late at night for us children without parents...
He doesn't just work! Rolan cooks for us, too!
And Rolan worked so hard to take care of him...
We owe who we are today to Rolan... I hope we can repay his kindness someday.
Rolan, welcome back!
Rolan, come play with us! Come on!
Rain, I heard about the airships... They say nearly all of them were destroyed...
Rain, whenever dangerous monsters appeared or there was a major incident, you and the airship squadron came to our rescue.
Rain, what's going to happen to Grandshelt now?
Yes, Rain. We trust you and the other knights.
Actually... Scott entrusted me with a letter for you, Commander Rain...
So that makes you my junior, then.

Hey, junior! Long time no see.
Have you been using your spellblade techniques?

Just as I thought, junior.
You've lived up to my expectations.
Wait a moment. Zile really is a knight of Grandshelt.
Zile, what brings you here?
About that, apparently Zile arranged everything ahead of time so we could get started as soon as you returned.
That takes care of the land route, too. And you gathered everything so quickly! Just what I'd expect from Raegen's sons!

Zile, if I remember right,
you joined the Order at the same time as Raegen, didn't you?
That's right. But you know, Raegen was remarkable from the moment he joined up. I guess you could say he was just naturally gifted.
I'll do what I can. If Raegen is leading the charge, I need to think about how I can help...
Even if the work isn't glamorous, never make light of it. Give it your full attention. I feel as though Zile taught me that.
We need to do our part, too, so Zile's support won't go to waste.

So that makes you my junior!
Good to meet you! I'm Silvia.
Hey, junior, have you heard of elves?

What, junior?
You won't help your senior out?
Just what I'd expect from my junior!

That wraps up my research here!
Thanks for coming along, junior!
See you, junior!
Are you looking into Mercedes?
I know just about everything there is to know. After all, I delivered Mercedes when she was born.
Mercedes is a kind girl. I imagine she even wants to look after the sailors who lost their jobs back in the previous Warden's time.
Whenever something upset Mercedes or she needed to think, she would go to Waterfall Way. She said the sound of the water calmed her.
Oh, Nichol...
Nichol... I'll be fine. *cough* *cough*
No... *cough* *cough* Nichol, please don't worry.
Nichol, what can I do for you?
Nichol, really?
Thank you, Nichol!
Nichol, what is this?
Jake... There's something that's been bothering me for a while...
Rain... Who’s the letter from?

Jake, Rain.
Thank you for everything.
Shera!? I thought you had been captured...
Here is the key to the throne room. Shera, please... save this country!
You lot! What are you doing here!? Wait... Jake!?
So you really were the one who installed that black box, Evan?
Evan, Verun, I've brought the dark matter.

See?
Don't rush, Lid.
Sincere feelings really do get through.

See?
Don't rush, Lid.
Sincere feelings really do get through.
Going on about money is my thing. It just doesn't suit Evan.
I wonder if I should tell Evan about Cid...
I'm so glad Evan is back to his old self.
My brother can't do a single household chore, you know?
I couldn't have brought my brother back on my own.
Yes... If anything happened to you, everyone would be in trouble...
